title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Augustana College, from the historic Hilltop neighborhood to the cultural hub of The District.

cards.title: College Hill District
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this eclectic neighborhood bordering campus to find local favorites like Fred & Ethel's 50's Antiques and Happy Joe's Pizza.
cards.short_summary: A walkable business district on the southern edge of campus known for its mid-century buildings and local shops.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Hill District is a walkable neighborhood composed of two distinct nodes along 14th Avenue, bordering the southern edge of the Augustana College campus.
cards.source_title: College Hill District | Rock Island, IL - RIGOV.org
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible street-level district; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: The District
cards.subtitle: 2nd Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Rock Island's cultural heart to explore art galleries and the Quad City Arts center, easily accessible via the free MetroLink bus.
cards.short_summary: Downtown Rock Island's arts and entertainment hub featuring galleries, theaters, and local retail.
cards.evidence_claim: The District is located about one kilometer from campus and serves as the city's cultural heart, featuring art galleries and live music.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; students can ride MetroLink for free with ID to reach this area.

cards.title: 38th Street
cards.subtitle: Campus Main Artery
cards.notes: Navigate this central thoroughfare to reach the Brunner Theatre Center and the main campus entrance from the south.
cards.short_summary: The primary north-south road running through the Augustana campus, connecting residential areas to academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: 38th Street is the main artery for Augustana, where students pass Swanson Commons and reach Centennial Hall at the 7th Avenue signal.
cards.access_notes: Public city street passing through the heart of the college campus.

cards.title: 7th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Northern Campus Edge
cards.notes: Walk along this street to access Centennial Hall and the northern parking facilities near the Slough path.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street that defines the northern boundary of the main campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: 7th Avenue is a key street at the northern edge of campus where Centennial Hall and its parking lot are located.
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; sidewalk access to campus buildings and the Slough.

cards.title: 30th Street
cards.subtitle: Hilltop Revitalization Zone
cards.notes: Explore the western edge of the Hilltop neighborhood where new community development projects are revitalizing local properties.
cards.short_summary: A key north-south street on the west side of the Hilltop district being developed for mixed-use retail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilltop CDC has purchased property at 30th Street and 14th Avenue, a five-minute walk from the southern edge of campus.
cards.source_title: Revitalization begins in College Hill | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public street area; currently undergoing neighborhood revitalization efforts.

cards.title: 11th Street
cards.subtitle: Embassy Square Corridor
cards.notes: Head west to this commercial strip to find local services and the Chopsticks House Chinese Restaurant at Embassy Square.
cards.short_summary: A commercial corridor west of campus featuring local shopping centers and dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Embassy Square Mall is located at 2365-2409 11th Street and features various shops and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street and shopping center; business hours vary.

cards.title: 4th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Downtown Dining Block
cards.notes: Stop by this downtown block for a caffeine fix at Awake Coffee Company or to explore local eateries near the riverfront.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street known for student-friendly coffee shops and proximity to the Mississippi riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Awake Coffee Company is located at 1430 4th Avenue in Downtown Rock Island.
cards.source_title: Downtown Rock Island Food And Drink Options
cards.access_notes: Public downtown street; coffee shop and restaurants have standard retail hours.

cards.title: 6th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Columbia Park Corridor
cards.notes: Check out the newer retail developments and strip centers located along this high-traffic artery near the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A busy commercial corridor north of campus featuring modern retail and office spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: LRC Real Estate has developed a strip center at 4015 6th Avenue, adjacent to Augustana College.
cards.source_title: Our New Rock Island Development - LRC Real Estate
cards.access_notes: Public street with commercial parking lots for retail customers.

cards.title: 10th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Residential Hall Row
cards.notes: Walk this quiet residential street to reach the Westerlin Residence Center and the campus public radio station, WVIK.
cards.short_summary: A residential street housing major student dormitories and the college's public radio facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westerlin Residence Center is located at 3200 10th Avenue on the Augustana campus.
cards.access_notes: Public street; residence hall access restricted to students and authorized guests.

cards.title: 42nd Street
cards.subtitle: Eastern Hilltop Boundary
cards.notes: Explore the eastern end of the College Hill District where the neighborhood transitions into local residential blocks.
cards.short_summary: The eastern boundary of the College Hill business district near the campus athletic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Hill District boundaries are concentrated at the intersections of 14th Avenue with 30th Street and 37th to 42nd Streets.
cards.source_title: College Hill District | Rock Island, IL - RIGOV.org
